Class DeveloperModeService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.DeveloperModeService
@Service public class DeveloperModeService extends Object
The Developer Mode switch (issue #217). Two gates: the ENABLE_DEVELOPER_MODE environment flag says whether the feature exists on this instance at all (it must stay false in production), and the developerMode row of global_settings says whether it is switched on. A later feature counts as enabled only when both hold, so a database edit alone can never turn fake data on where the flag is off.
